findings: RGBA8 baked main, alternate and restored poses are severely distorted.
RGBA8 realtime skinning is visually normal.
Float WebGL2 and WebGL1 are visually normal according to root review.
priorVisualReview.imageProcessing: None; screenshots were neither cropped nor modified.
priorVisualReview.requiredResolution: Identify and fix the RGBA8 baked-skinning defect, then rerun actual runtime/close-up visual evidence before accepting B3.

priorInvalidation.finding: Custom texture widths 64 (RGBA32F) and 128 (RGBA8) can split a joint across rows, but Creator 3.8.8 LBS shader samples the full joint at one y coordinate with CLAMP. The former numeric validators did not check this invariant.
priorInvalidation.affectedEvidence: All three historical fixture runs used the invalid custom layout. Float screenshots being normal at sampled instants does not establish row safety.
priorInvalidation.localCorrection: Custom layout changed to 72 for RGBA32F and engine-doubled 144 for RGBA8. Runtime validator now requires actual width alignment and observed jointTexturePixelOffset alignment.

resolvedCauses.cause: Custom 64/128 widths can split a joint over rows while shader reads one y coordinate.
resolvedCauses.fix: Custom 72 gives actual float72 / RGBA8 144; actual widths/offsets validated.

resolvedCauses.cause: Incomplete old injection retained float render-target: features17 and shader macro1 with RGBA8.
resolvedCauses.fix: Mask OES float/linear plus dependent WEBGL/EXT float color-buffer aliases; actual features16 and pipeline/compiled shader macro0.
